name: Flashlight
description: The whole screen as a light - white at full or half brightness or red.
author: WhyOS-Apps contributors

whyos.summary: The whole screen as a light: white at full or half brightness, or red.
whyos.description:
Three modes: white at 100%, white at 50% and red at 100%. The square,
triangle and cross choose one, the arrow keys step through them and the
diamond shows the help. The mode you used last comes back the next time.

For the first two seconds the screen stays at the badge's own brightness
and shows the keys in the bar at the bottom, so a dark room is not lit
at once. Then the keys go and the whole screen is the light. The screen stays on until you close
the app with Esc or the logo key, and the brightness goes back to your
setting.
whyos.changelog: The SDK's fixes of WhyOS 59c4625: standby in the first two seconds no longer keeps the badge busy, and the help always lists Esc and the logo key.
